Library `lib` declares only `const LIMIT = 42`, so the member is unresolved, and the code is DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_QUALIFIED_CONST, as `compiler/LIMP.9.8h` pins it for an expression. A compiler that looked up the leading `lib` alone refuses it with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_BINDING instead.
